06-03-1337 is March 6, 1337.  
330 days later:  
1337 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1337 not divisible by 4).  
Days in months after March 6, 1337:  
March: 25 days left (31-6), April: 30, May: 31, June: 30, July: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31.  
Sum to end of 1337 = 25+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 300 days.  
330 - 300 = 30 days into 1338.  
January 1338: 30 days → Jan 30, 1338.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1338-01-30
